snippet.title: ASTRAL Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist ASTRAL on Steam

ASTRAL is a first-person shooter set in a futuristic universe. Embody a GRD robot and engage adversaries in dynamic environments, spanning Earth and Off-World locations. Utilize comprehensive weapon customization to craft your personalized loadout, preparing you for intense kinetic action!
